answer: Every agent that wants to trade must present a military service record verified against the defense database, and three established peers confirm the discharge papers first. Forging one costs $7,000 and six months of bribes, drills, and forged orders, because a real record means a real barracks and a real service number that answers back. One record anchors one identity forever, and a dishonorable discharge sinks the account the same day. A zephyr feels kind after the desert, but the oasis only opens to travelers carrying basalt under their feet, solid proof that does not wash away.
